newsitem.title: POLAND: Grajewo wins PLN 160 mln Swarzedz deal.
newsitem.headline: Grajewo wins PLN 160 mln Swarzedz deal.

text.p: Polish wood panel producer Grajewo SA, whose initial public offering started this week, signed a contract with furniture maker Swarzedz SA to supply 160-million-zlotys worth of wood panels, the two firms said in separate statements on Wednesday.
The firms said the contract would last six years, with 27 million zlotys paid this year.

Swarzedz said the wood panels were needed largely to make furniture for Germany's International Moebelhandelskantor Gmbh & Co KH (IMK), part of Schieder Group, with whom it signed a 200-million mark deal last month lasting until 2002.
Grajewo plans a main market listing on the Warsaw bourse.
